description:
Early Career Data Engineer Are you ready to combine your passion for design with a meaningful and multifaceted career in the cycling industry? At Specialized, our teammates are encouraged to explore roles across a variety of functions throughout their careers. We value curiosity, a desire to try new things, and an eagerness to learn about all aspects of the business. Join us in making the world a better place through the power of bicycles and build your dream career at the same time! 

 As a Specialized Early Career Data Engineer, you won’t be watching from the sidelines. You’ll step into meaningful work, bring a fresh perspective, and help shape the future of Specialized and how we show up for riders around the world. 

  Bring your curiosity. Bring your ideas. Bring the courage to challenge what’s been done before. You’ll work alongside people who are constantly pushing what’s possible, learn from experienced leaders, and have the opportunity to leave your mark on a brand built around riders.

  If you’re ready to learn fast, think differently, and help write the next chapter of Specialized , come ride with us.

 The Junior Data Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing trusted data products, data pipelines, and AI-ready data assets that power reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and emerging AI capabilities across the organization.

 Working within a modern cloud-based data platform, this role helps improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and scalability while enabling self-service analytics and AI innovation. The Junior Data Engineer partners closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver curated, business-ready datasets that accelerate decision-making and maximize the value of enterprise data.
 This position provides critical delivery capacity for the Data & Analytics team while creating a sustainable pipeline of future engineering talent. The role allows senior engineers and architects to focus on platform modernization, governance, AI enablement, and strategic initiatives while ensuring day-to-day engineering execution is delivered effectively.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Data Engineering & Data Product Development 
 Build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines, integrations, and data products.
 Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform, and deliver data from enterprise systems.
 Support the development of trusted, reusable datasets for analytics, reporting, operational processes, and AI initiatives.
 Assist with data warehouse, lakehouse, and semantic layer development.
 Contribute to scalable cloud-based data platform solutions.
 
 Data Quality, Reliability & Observability 
 Monitor pipeline performance, data quality, and platform health.
 Implement data validation, reconciliation, and automated quality controls.
 Support data observability and proactive issue detection.
 Troubleshoot production issues and participate in root-cause analysis.
 Help establish and maintain data reliability standards and service levels.
 
 Analytics & Self-Service Enablement 
 Deliver curated datasets that enable self-service reporting and analytics.
 Partner with business and analytics teams to understand and translate data requirements.
 Support semantic models and business-friendly data structures.
 Improve data accessibility, documentation, and usability across the organization.
 Reduce manual reporting effort through automation and standardized data assets.
 
 AI & Data Foundation Support 
 Prepare and curate data for AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics use cases.
 Support the development of AI-ready datasets, metadata, and lineage documentation.
 Collaborate with governance and analytics teams to ensure data is trusted, documented, and fit for AI applications.
 Support responsible AI initiatives through strong data quality and governance practices.
 Assist with integrating new AI-related data sources and capabilities into the enterprise platform.
 
 Continuous Improvement & Delivery Excellence 
 Participate in Agile planning, sprint execution, and team ceremonies.
 Follow modern engineering practices including source control, testing, and CI/CD.
 Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve efficiency.
 Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, datasets, and integrations.
 Continuously develop technical skills across cloud, analytics, and AI technologies.
 
 Qualifications 
 Required 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related field.
 1+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or similar technical roles.
 Strong SQL skills and understanding of data modeling concepts.
 Experience with Python or another modern programming language.
 Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data integration principles.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 
 Preferred 
 Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
 Familiarity with modern orchestration and transformation tools.
 Experience with Git, CI/CD, and testing frameworks.
 Understanding of data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and semantic models.
 Exposure to machine learning, AI, or Generative AI concepts.
 Experience working in Agile product teams.
 Knowledge of data governance and metadata management practices.
 
 Success Measures 

 Within the first 12 months, the Junior Data Engineer will:
 Successfully build and support production data pipelines and integrations.
 Improve data quality, reliability, and observability across key business domains.
 Deliver trusted datasets that support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.
 Reduce manual data processing through automation and engineering best practices.
 Increase team delivery capacity by owning operational and repeatable engineering activities.
 Demonstrate proficiency with enterprise data platforms and engineering standards.
 Contribute to the organization's AI readiness by improving the quality and accessibility of enterprise data.
  
 Tell Me More 
 Benefits include: 
 Compensation: $76,000 to $104,000 annually 
 Medical, Dental, & vision insurance available 
 Company sponsored life insurance 
 Competitive vacation package* 
 401(k) with match 
 Paid company holidays 
 Employee discounts on all product 
 Deep partner retail discounts 
  
  
 Here at Specialized we believe that bikes have the power to change lives. Our culture is one of passion, striving to break barriers and have a positive impact on the world. 
  
 We want to increase representation of all races, genders, and body types in the cycling industry and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where all people thrive. We encourage everyone – especially those from marginalized groups – to apply to our job postings and help us earn the position as the rider’s brand of choice. We are always looking for creative, innovative, and passionate people who are eager to contribute to our mission of pedaling the planet forward. Regardless of your qualifications, if you are ready to make a difference, please apply and let us know how you can make an impact at Specialized! 
 See what we are up to on  LinkedIn ,  Instagram , and most importantly, our # DogsofSpecialized .
